blind_read: The seated monkey lowered its eyelids, nodded off, lifted its chin for a short breath, then settled back into a doze.

evidence.observation: The lowering brow starts the nod while the hands stay supported on the knees. Two cyan pixels at (27,53) and (27,54) form a small vertical stripe beside the left heel; the stripe disappears in the next pose.
The head hangs forward with closed eyes, then the muzzle tips up on the breath. Hands, belly and feet remain warm and clearly separated from the recolored coat.

blockers: In the second exposure the cyan stripe beside the heel flashes against the cream ground. Stray cyan dots shift to the head and tail on the following exposures.
